nodes.label: NEXT.js SVG Logo Asset
nodes.rationale: A 394×80 web-ready SVG stored in the public asset directory. Its solid black NEXT.js wordmark and transparent canvas indicate that it is intended to display Next.js brand identity in a web interface.

nodes.label: NEXT.js Wordmark
nodes.rationale: The central visual element is the name NEXT in wide geometric uppercase forms followed by a lowercase dotted j and rounded lowercase s.

nodes.label: Black Monochrome Brand Styling
nodes.rationale: The entire mark uses a single solid black fill (#000) on a transparent background, with no gradients, shadows, outlines, or additional colors.

nodes.label: Next.js Brand Identification
nodes.rationale: The asset serves as a compact brand mark for visually identifying Next.js, rather than depicting a product UI, data, or explanatory diagram.
